```json
 "topology": "NMOS-input 5T OTA preamp + PMOS common-source gain stage + CMOS output inverter",
 "rationale": "Pinned at VCM 0.9 V, an NMOS input pair leaves about 0.25 V across the tail device. The PMOS CS device copies the mirror's gm/Id and L, so its Vsg matches the mirror diode and systematic offset stays low. Short PMOS L keeps node capacitance low, so the GBW-limited delay is roughly 2 ns. Budget: 10 µA ref + 30 µA tail + 40 µA CS = 80 µA, about 144 µW. The inverter gives rail-to-rail output into 50 fF with no static current."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L_in":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),       # input pair L
    "gmid_p":  (8.0, 5.0, 12.0),       # PMOS mirror + CS stage gm/Id (shared -> matched Vsg)
    "L_p":     (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),       # PMOS mirror + CS stage L (shared)
    "I_tail":  (30e-6, 15e-6, 45e-6),  # preamp tail current
    "I_cs":    (40e-6, 15e-6, 50e-6),  # CS stage current
    "L_n":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS bias-mirror L
    "W_inv":   (1.5, 0.6, 4.0),        # inverter NMOS width (PMOS = 2.7x)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    It, Ics = p["I_tail"], p["I_cs"]
    Ih = It / 2.0

    # --- NMOS bias mirror: ibias diode, tail source, CS load (same gm/Id, same L) ---
    gmid_n = 10.0
    mref = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["L_n"], iref, vds=0.65)
    mref = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["L_n"], iref, vds=mref.vgs)
    mtail = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["L_n"], It, vds=0.25)
    mload = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["L_n"], Ics, vds=0.9)

    # --- Input pair: iterate on the source voltage to account for body effect ---
    vs = 0.25
    for _ in range(4):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Ih, vds=0.5, vsb=vs)
        vs = max(0.12, vcm - m1.vgs)

    # --- PMOS mirror load and CS stage share gm/Id and L, so their Vsg matches ---
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], Ih, vds=1.0)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], Ih, vds=m3.vgs)
    m5 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], Ics, vds=0.9)
    vx = vdd - m3.vgs   # preamp output DC level

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mtail)
    # preamp: diode on the vinp side, output on the vinn side (rises when vinp > vinn)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # CS stage: x up -> y down
    n.dev("M5", "y", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m5)
    n.dev("M6", "y", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mload)
    # output inverter: y down -> vout up  (vout HIGH when vinp > vinn)
    Wn = p["W_inv"]
    Wp = 2.7 * Wn
    n.M("MIN", "vout", "y", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, 0.15)
    n.M("MIP", "vout", "y", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, 0.15)

    # --- Predictions ---
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m5.gm / (m5.gds + mload.gds)
    cinv = 1.0e-15 * (Wn + Wp) * 1.5
    # preamp output node: Miller-multiplied CS gate capacitance + drain caps
    cx = m5.cgg + m5.cgd * A2 + m3.cdd + m1.cdd + 2e-15
    cy = cinv + m5.cdd + mload.cdd + 2e-15
    # GBW-limited zero crossing at the preamp output (ln2 * A*C/gm)
    t1 = 0.69 * A1 * cx / m1.gm
    t1 = min(t1, cx * (A1 * vod * 2) / max(m1.gm * vod, 1e-9))
    # CS output: slew over ~VDD/2 limited by the smaller of the pull-up and pull-down currents
    t2 = cy * 0.9 / Ics
    # inverter driving CL
    ion = 150e-6 * Wn
    t3 = (cl + 5e-15) * 0.9 / ion
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3

    power = vdd * (iref + It + Ics)
    offset = 0.002 + abs(vx - (vdd - m5.vgs)) / max(A1, 1.0)

    return n, {
        "tpd": tpd,
        "power": power,
        "offset": offset,
        "polarity_ok": 1,
        "gain_db": db(A1 * A2 * 10.0),
    }
```
